name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: September Week 2 - Formulas and Charts
description: Practice words for formulas, functions, and chart interpretation.

words.definition: A rule that calculates a value.
words.example: The formula added the weekly practice scores.

words.definition: A built-in formula tool, such as AVERAGE.
words.example: The AVERAGE function found the class mean.

words.definition: A number found by adding values and dividing by how many values there are.
words.example: The average showed the typical score for the group.
The minimum showed the lowest typing score.
The maximum showed the highest quiz score.

words.definition: A visual that helps explain spreadsheet results.
words.example: The chart compared scores across the class.

words.definition: An explanation of what data means.
words.example: The interpretation explained why one week improved.
